---
title: "DESeq2_explained"
format: html
---

```{r}
library(tidyverse)
library(ggbeeswarm)
```

```{r}
sig_summary <- read_csv("../../output/06_deg/spawnnight/sig_summary.csv")
norm_130_df <- read_csv("../../output/06_deg/spawnnight/norm_130_df.csv")
metadata <- read_csv("../../metadata/metadata_or.csv")
```

```{r}
top_gene <- sig_summary %>% 
  arrange(desc(log2FoldChange)) %>% 
  slice(1) %>% 
  pull(gene_id)
```

```{r}
plot_top <- norm_130_df %>% 
  dplyr::filter(gene_id == top_gene) %>% 
  pivot_longer(cols = 2:last_col(), names_to = "sample_id") %>% 
  left_join(metadata)%>% 
  mutate(
    hpf = factor(hpf, levels = c(4, 9, 14)),
    leachate = factor(leachate, levels = c("control", "low", "mid", "high"))
  )

plot_sum <- plot_top %>% 
  group_by(group, hpf, stage, leachate) %>% 
  summarize(mean_expr = mean(value)) %>% 
  mutate(
    hpf = factor(hpf, levels = c(4, 9, 14)),
    leachate = factor(leachate, levels = c("control", "low", "mid", "high")),
    stage = factor(stage, levels = c("cleavage", "prawnchip", "earlygastrula"))
  )
```
```{r}
theme_mcap <- theme_sleek_axe <- function() {
  theme_minimal() +
    theme(
      panel.border = element_rect(
        color = "grey70",
        fill = NA,
        linewidth = 0.5
      ),
      axis.line.x  = element_line(color = "grey70"),
      axis.line.y  = element_line(color = "grey70"),
      
      plot.title = element_text(
        size  = 12,
        color = "grey40",
        hjust = 0.5,
        margin = margin(b = 20)
      ),
      
      strip.text = element_text(size = 10, color = "grey40"),
      
      plot.subtitle = element_text(
        size   = 10,
        color  = "grey40",
        hjust  = 0.5,
        margin = margin(b = 40)
      ),
      
      axis.title = element_text(size = 10, color = "grey40"),
      axis.text = element_text(size = 10, color = "grey40"),
      legend.title = element_text(size = 10, color = "grey40"),
      legend.text = element_text(size = 10, color = "grey40")
    )
}


leachate.colors <- c(control = "#AEF1FF", 
                     low     = "#BBC7FF",
                     mid     = "#7D8BFF", 
                     high    = "#592F7D")

stage.5.colors <- c(egg           = "#FFE362",
                    cleavage      = "#EBA600", 
                    morula        = "#E6AA83",
                    prawnchip     = "#D9685B", 
                    earlygastrula = "#A2223C")

stage.3.colors <- c(cleavage      = "#EBA600", 
                    prawnchip     = "#D9685B", 
                    earlygastrula = "#A2223C")

status.colors <- c(typical   = "#75C165", 
                   uncertain = "#E3FAA5", 
                   malformed = "#8B0069")

night.colors <- c(July_6th = "#E3FAA5", 
                  July_7th = "#578B21", 
                  July_8th = "#1E2440")

night.colors.alt <- c(July_6th = "#21918C", 
                      July_7th = "#201158", 
                      July_8th = "#1E2440")
```


```{r}
ggplot(plot_sum, aes(x=leachate, y=mean_expr, fill=leachate)) + 
  geom_point(shape=21, size=5, color="grey20")+
  labs(
    y = "Log2 Normalized Gene Expression",
    x = ""
  ) +
  geom_hline(yintercept=41.49945, linetype="dashed", color="grey40")+
  scale_fill_manual(values=leachate.colors) +
  theme_mcap()
```

```{r}
ggplot(plot_sum, aes(x=leachate, y=mean_expr, fill=stage)) + 
  geom_point(shape=21, size=5, color="grey20")+
  labs(
    y = "Log2 Normalized Gene Expression",
    x = ""
  ) +
  guides(fill = guide_legend(reverse = TRUE)) +
  geom_hline(yintercept=41.49945, linetype="dashed", color="grey20") +
  scale_fill_manual(values=stage.3.colors) +
  theme_mcap()
```
```{r}
p_stage <- ggplot(
  plot_sum,
  aes(
    x = leachate,
    y = mean_expr,
    fill = stage,
    group = stage
  )
) + 
  geom_point(shape = 21, size = 5, color = "grey20") +
  geom_hline(yintercept = 41.49945, linetype = "dashed", color = "grey20") +
  scale_fill_manual(values = stage.3.colors) +
  guides(fill = guide_legend(reverse = TRUE)) +
  labs(
    y = "Log2 Normalized Gene Expression",
    x = ""
  ) +
  theme_mcap()

stage_reveal <- reveal_groups(
  p_stage,
  order = c(1,2,3,4)
)

stage_reveal
```
```{r}
for(i in seq_along(stage_reveal)) {

  ggsave(
    filename = paste0("../../figs/reveal_", i, ".png"),
    plot = revealed[[i]],
    width = 8,
    height = 4.5,
    dpi = 900
  )

}
```
